class.name: GameplayAbility
class.brief_description: Resource describing an activatable ability and its tag gating.
class.description: Identified by its ability name and optionally bound to an input action. Activation is gated by tags: required tags must be present on the owner, blocked tags must be absent, and owned tags are granted for as long as the ability runs. Extend in GDScript and override [code]_on_give_ability[/code], [code]_can_activate_ability[/code], [code]_activate_ability[/code], [code]_end_ability[/code] and the input hooks. These are virtual methods to override, not signals to connect to.

method.name: _activate_ability
method.description: Override with what the ability actually does. [b]Call [method end_ability] when it is finished[/b] - nothing ends it for you.

method.name: _can_activate_ability
method.description: Override to add your own condition on top of the tag gates: enough stamina, a target in range, off cooldown. Return [code]false[/code] to refuse.

method.name: _end_ability
method.description: Override to clean up. [param was_canceled] is true when something interrupted the ability rather than it running to completion.

method.name: _input_pressed
method.description: Override to react to the driving input going down while the ability is active - a charge starting, a held beam.

method.name: _input_released
method.description: Override to react to the driving input coming up - releasing a charged shot, or ending a held ability.

method.name: _on_give_ability
method.description: Override to set the ability up when it is granted - before it ever activates. Runs once per granted instance.

method.name: activate_ability
method.description: Starts the ability: grants [member activation_owned_tags], cancels what [member cancel_abilities_with_tag] names, and calls [method _activate_ability]. It does [b]not[/b] re-check [method can_activate_ability], so call that first unless you mean to force it.

method.name: apply_effect_to_owner
method.description: Applies [param effect] to the component that owns this ability, returning the same handle as [method AbilitySystemComponent.apply_gameplay_effect_to_self]. This is how an ability spends a cost or applies its own buff.

method.name: can_activate_ability
method.description: Checks the tag gates - [member activation_required_tags], [member activation_blocked_tags], and whether another ability is blocking this one - and then [method _can_activate_ability]. Both have to pass.

method.name: end_ability
method.description: Ends the ability, releasing its owned tags and calling [method _end_ability]. Pass [code]true[/code] for [param was_canceled] when something interrupted it rather than it finishing. [b]An ability that never calls this stays active and keeps blocking.[/b]

method.name: get_ability_id
method.description: This instance's id, unique across every ability granted this run. Granting the same template twice yields two instances with different ids.

method.name: get_ability_system_component
method.description: The component this ability was granted to.

method.name: get_id_counter
method.description: The counter ids are drawn from. Exposed for tooling; a project has no reason to read it.

method.name: get_is_active
method.description: Whether the ability is running - between [method activate_ability] and [method end_ability].

method.name: get_is_input_pressed
method.description: Whether the input driving this ability is currently held. Maintained by [method input_pressed] and [method input_released].

method.name: get_source_object
method.description: Whatever was passed to [method AbilitySystemComponent.give_ability] as the source - the weapon, item or actor that granted the ability. Null when nothing was given.

method.name: increment_id_counter
method.description: Advances the id counter. Exposed for tooling; a project has no reason to call it.

method.name: input_pressed
method.description: Tells the ability its input went down; calls [method _input_pressed].

method.name: input_released
method.description: Tells the ability its input came up; calls [method _input_released].

method.name: on_give_ability
method.description: Runs the grant-time hook. Called by [method AbilitySystemComponent.give_ability]; override [method _on_give_ability] instead of calling this.

method.name: set_is_input_pressed
method.description: Sets the held flag by hand. Normally [method input_pressed] and [method input_released] do this.

method.name: setup_ability
method.description: Binds a freshly granted instance to its component and source. [method AbilitySystemComponent.give_ability] calls this; a project does not.

members.member: The name [method AbilitySystemComponent.try_activate_ability] looks this ability up by. It has to be unique within one component.
What this ability [i]is[/i]. Other abilities and effects match against these - notably [member cancel_abilities_with_tag] and [member block_abilities_with_tag].
The owner must hold none of these for the ability to activate.
Tags the owner holds for as long as this ability is active. Reference counted, so another source granting the same tag keeps it alive after this ability ends.
The owner must hold every one of these for the ability to activate.
While this ability is active, abilities whose [member ability_tags] match cannot start.
Activating this ability cancels every active ability whose [member ability_tags] match.
The input action [method AbilitySystemComponent.ability_local_input_pressed] routes to this ability. Bind the action on the [Pawn] and forward it; the ability never reads input itself.

signal.name: ability_ended
signal.description: Emitted when the ability ends, however it ended.
